findings.title_en: Worker on a high ladder without a safety helmet
Worker leaning outside the sides of the ladder while working
Unable to verify ladder base stability

summary_en: Three findings were recorded: two high severity, no medium severity, and one low-severity uncertain finding. The most urgent item is the worker working on a high ladder without a helmet while leaning outside the ladder sides. Ladder work in this area must stop immediately until a helmet is provided, the ladder position is corrected, and its base is verified.
